title: HTML Forms for Beginners: Build Your First Form
description:
Learn how an HTML form groups input controls, and try a simple beginner form example.

What would your first form collect: feedback or a sign-up?

Next lesson: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MEEDwR24JOw
Full beginner course: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLEJDqf_3IqMU

Give controls labels so people can understand what to enter.
The name attribute identifies a field when form data is submitted.

Try it: Create a labeled email field and a submit button.


Web Development in 60 Seconds • Lesson 14
Learn more: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Core/Structuring_content
